findings.title: Coverage ratchet is set below the committed baseline
findings.evidence: tools/Test-CoverageFloor.ps1:28-30 says the measured baseline is 64.7% but sets the default CI floor to 64.0; docs/TestSuiteRemediation-Plan.md:172-174 also records that the floor was set at the measured 64.7%. With a coverage report at 64.1%, tools/Test-CoverageFloor.ps1:89-101 rounds/calculates 64.1 and compares it to 64.0, so the step does not fail.
findings.predicted_failure: A PR can delete tests and drop the scoped security-critical coverage from the committed 64.7% baseline to any value at or above 64.0%, and CI still exits 0. The coverage gate therefore does not actually ratchet against coverage going down.
